WITH drug_class AS (
  SELECT concept_id,
         CASE
           WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%oxybutynin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tolterodine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%solifenacin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%darifenacin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%fesoterodine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%trospium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%benztropine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%trihexyphenidyl%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%diphenhydramine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hydroxyzine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%amitriptyline%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nortriptyline%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%imipramine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%doxepin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%paroxetine%' THEN 'anticholinergic'
           WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%zolpidem%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%eszopiclone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%zaleplon%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%temazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%triazolam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%flurazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%estazolam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%lorazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alprazolam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%clonazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%diazepam%' THEN 'sedative_hypnotic'
         END AS class
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND standard_concept='S' AND (
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%oxybutynin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tolterodine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%solifenacin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%darifenacin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%fesoterodine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%trospium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%benztropine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%trihexyphenidyl%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%diphenhydramine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hydroxyzine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%amitriptyline%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nortriptyline%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%imipramine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%doxepin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%paroxetine%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%zolpidem%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%eszopiclone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%zaleplon%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%temazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%triazolam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%flurazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%estazolam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%lorazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alprazolam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%clonazepam%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%diazepam%'
  )
), exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, dc.class, de.drug_exposure_id, de.drug_concept_id,
         de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date,
         COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, DATEADD(day, COALESCE(de.days_supply, 30), de.drug_exposure_start_date)) AS end_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_class dc ON dc.concept_id=de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= '2015-01-01' AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < '2025-01-01'
), candidate AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, e.class, e.drug_exposure_id, e.end_date AS index_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.person_id, e.class ORDER BY e.end_date DESC, e.drug_exposure_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM exposures e
  WHERE e.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM exposures e2
      WHERE e2.person_id=e.person_id AND e2.class=e.class
        AND e2.start_date > e.end_date AND e2.start_date <= DATEADD(day,90,e.end_date)
    )
), indexed AS (
  SELECT c.person_id, c.class, c.index_date
  FROM candidate c
  JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id=c.person_id
  WHERE c.rn=1 AND DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth,1,1), c.index_date) >= 65
), multimorbidity AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.class, i.index_date
  FROM indexed i
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=i.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-365,i.index_date) AND i.index_date
  GROUP BY i.person_id, i.class, i.index_date
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT co.condition_concept_id) >= 2
), polypharmacy AS (
  SELECT m.person_id, m.class, m.index_date
  FROM multimorbidity m
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id=m.person_id
    AND de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-90,m.index_date) AND m.index_date
  GROUP BY m.person_id, m.class, m.index_date
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT de.drug_concept_id) >= 5
), falls AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id, p.class, p.index_date
  FROM polypharmacy p
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=p.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date > p.index_date AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,90,p.index_date)
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE c.concept_id IN (432787,437176,441190,46270328)
     OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE 'fall %'
     OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE 'falling injury%'
     OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '% due to fall%'
)
SELECT p.class AS deprescribed_class,
       COUNT(*) AS deprescribing_episodes,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS persons,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.person_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS falls_90d,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN f.person_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)/COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,3)) AS fall_proportion_pct
FROM polypharmacy p
LEFT JOIN falls f ON f.person_id=p.person_id AND f.class=p.class AND f.index_date=p.index_date
GROUP BY p.class
ORDER BY fall_proportion_pct ASC

Mechanistically, I would expect **sedative-hypnotic deprescribing** to be followed by the lower short-term fall proportion, because benzodiazepines and Z-drugs directly enhance **GABA-A–mediated inhibition**, causing sedation, delayed reaction time, impaired cerebellar/vestibular coordination, gait instability, and nocturnal confusion. Reducing them can rapidly improve arousal and psychomotor balance.

Anticholinergic deprescribing is also biologically plausible for fall reduction: it restores **central muscarinic acetylcholine signaling** important for attention, executive function, visuospatial processing, and gait control, and may reduce delirium/blurred vision/urinary retention. But its benefit may be less immediate or more heterogeneous than removing GABAergic sedatives.

So: **expected lower 90-day fall proportion: sedative-hypnotic deprescribing**, but this is a mechanistic inference here, not a verified MedCP cohort result.
